text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Insane...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wow! This year's Derby champion really
barreled
through to the end!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the crowd is going wild! I was a
little
worried about this year's Derby
because of how
incredible the Oaks was.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: The Oaks?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I know what you mean! That girl's running was off the charts! Seeing her even just once left such a lasting impression!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I heard she's completed her registration
for the
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. She's
seriously on a
whole different level.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Just talking about it makes me wanna
see her run
again. She's a total superstar
in the making!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Seriously?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...So, the Oaks was more impressive than
this
year's Derby, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Really?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Whew...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
What do you want to do about
Nakayama Festa's
interview?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
The main feature's gonna be the girl who
ran in
the Oaks... but we might as well
get a quick word
from Nakayama Festa
too, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You're kidding me. This is the Derby we just finished.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, considering how much I've boasted before today, good results alone won't win their confidence.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Unless I prove I've got the absolute
strength to
foster people's expectations
and hope, I won't be
changing any
minds.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Using that metric, the Oaks
Umamusume's got a
passing grade. She's
won five out of six races and
was voted
as the favorite for each of them.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: No question, she's heroine material.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Steady growth won't cut it. In the end,
it's the
explosive, firework-like radiance
that grabs
people's attention.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I've pulled it off once. Remember when I
crashed
El's press conference and
declared her to be my
rival?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That's what got me so much attention for
my
debut race.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Murmur, murmur...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: But that effect wears off.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
As time goes on, the only ones left are
the real
contenders. Passing waves break
and turn to foam
in an instant, but
unwavering strength stands the
test of
time.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You've been a handful ever since
we met.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Right. Kyoto's 3,000-meter turf race will
be a
good opportunity to show I've got
the stamina to
handle European turf.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, I have to finish in the
top three.

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
Wow, the classic year Umamusume really
showed
off their strength this year.

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed! Especially the racer who's
been
dominating the Tiara tour! We can
surely expect
big things from her! And
now, moving onto our
next news...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Fes...ta.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I'm coming in. How are you feeling
today?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Doc...tor...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me. You don't need to push
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
We need to start considering the next
steps. I'd
like you to discuss the
treatment plan we spoke
about with
your father.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...Okay.
